def R2KeyPairAt (sc : ScannerState) (start gram : SurfPos) (own : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ RegisterWitness.markedCols sc, a ≠ own →
    ∀ mid i c : SurfPos, SSLComments gram mid → SIndent own mid i → GLit ':' i c →
    ∀ v : SurfPos, SBlockIndented own .blockOut c v → ExplValueLine start a v
